digest.component_or_area: local LLM configuration and developer gates
propositions: Local developer gates must be configured to resolve model classes to Bedrock inference profiles instead of direct Anthropic endpoints to enable pre-production testing before S8 production cutover.

Prompt caching must engage and produce nonzero cache_read_tokens on the Bedrock path across all three gate types (review-plan, review-code, verify-completion) to prove genuine cache utilization rather than write-only failure mode.
Structured output validation must succeed on all three gate runs against Bedrock without fallback to unparsed or INDETERMINATE shapes, confirming provider-parity in verdict envelope generation.

Configuration must be reversible in a single step via environment variable toggle (REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE) without code changes, allowing developers to switch between Bedrock and Anthropic without friction.
Bedrock's cachePoint TTL defaults to 5 minutes matching Anthropic's cache_control default, eliminating the premise of substantive difference between providers' cache lifetime handling.
